topics.topic: How prepare_request receives selected-instance name/absence to distinguish instance_not_selected vs instance_address_missing
questions: How does prepare_request receive the selected instance name (or explicit absence) so it can deterministically distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`?
How does prepare_request receive the selected-instance name needed to distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`?

quotes:
The current ManifestOperation M10 — and beside it, not in it, the selected
instance's name — with that instance's `base_url`, `required_headers` and
`instance_class` as read — the name absent when none is selected, the others
absent when missing — or `binding_stale` for any failure of the record itself
(A08 rule 6).

State 3 order after the binding: no selected instance (no name), no
`api_base_url` (a name without one), a repeated required header, a plain `http`
target not allowed, then the credential, then input placement, input ports in
name order and a list's elements in list order, the first that cannot be placed
named (A09 rules 1, 2, 4, 6);
judgement.why: The texts already specify that selected-instance name/absence is returned alongside the manifest operation and is then used to distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing` in prepare-order checks.

topics.topic: Authoritative source of binding ports for request/response shaping at send time
questions: Which operation is authoritative for supplying binding ports to `effects` at send time: `check_binding_current`, a separate `read_binding`, or cached flow data?

topics.topic: Behavior when list_records filter references a non-existent entity (error vs empty result)
questions: When inspection is scoped by a reference that does not exist (for example `run_id`), must the kernel return `unknown_reference` or an empty page?

topics.topic: Canonical file-byte digest algorithm and encoding across store/sandbox/service paths
questions: What exact digest algorithm and encoding must be used for file bytes (spooled files and fixtures) when callers supply/compare digests?

topics.topic: Input shape for runs.capture_failed_execution (full NodeExecution payload vs identity tuple)
questions: Does the caller pass a full NodeExecution record payload, or only its identity tuple (`run_id`, `node_id`, `map_index`, `attempt_number`)?

topics.topic: Required effect of Actor argument in store.record_change when target record has no actor field
questions: For store changes whose target records have no actor field, what observable effect must the passed Actor have (persisted audit metadata, ignored, or validated only)?

topics.topic: Service set to iterate in bindings.check_installed_instances at startup
questions: Which set of services must be iterated at start: all services in installation config, only services with a selected instance, only services with credentials, or another set?

topics.topic: Where unresolved-credential failures are surfaced (installation refusal vs prepare_request pre-send non-refusal failure)
questions: Is unresolved credential propagated as a refusal from `installation`, or converted into a non-refusal pre-send failure result of `prepare_request`?

topics.topic: functions.read_slot activation history scope (per contract version vs current version only)
